headings.title: Commands Deprecated or Removed in BIG-IP LTM 11.6.0

text:
BIG-IP LTM v11.6.0
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 11.6.0
ANTIFRAUD::disable
- disables the
anti-fraud plugin
ANTIFRAUD::enable
- enables the
anti-fraud plugin
BIGTCP::release_flow
- Transition
layer 7 FIX message to layer 4
BWC::measure
- start or stop measurement
on a per policy or on a per flow basis
BWC::pps
- allows modification of the packets
per second for the session
CATEGORY::analytics
- enables or
disables the analytics server on a per request basis
CATEGORY::filetype
- checks for the
mime type and mime subtype of an HTTP request payload
CATEGORY::matchtype
- stores the
match result in the specified variable
CATEGORY::safesearch
- checks for
safe search parameters for the given URL
DATAGRAM::ip
- returns ip header
information
DATAGRAM::ip6
- returns ipv6 header
information
DATAGRAM::tcp
- returns tcp header
information.
DHCP::version
- returns the DHCP version
DHCPv4::hlen
- Returns hlen (hardware len)
field from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv4::htype
- Returns htype (hardware
type) field from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv4::chaddr
- Returns chaddr (client
hardware address) from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv4::ciaddr
- Returns ciaddr (client
IP) field from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv4::drop
- Drops the packet silently
DHCPv4::giaddr
- Returns giaddr (gateway
or relay IP) field from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv4::hops
- Returns hops (num. of hops)
field from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv4::len
- Returns the length of the DHCP
packet length
DHCPv4::opcode
- Returns opcode field
from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv4::option
- Retrieves or sets the
option by id number x
DHCPv4::reject
- Drops the packet while
sending ICMP packet about the drop reason
DHCPv4::secs
- Returns xid (transaction ID)
field from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv4::siaddr
- Returns siaddr (server
IP) field from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv4::type
- Returns type of DHCPv4
message
DHCPv4::xid
- Returns xid (transaction ID)
field from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv4::yiaddr
- Returns yiaddr (your IP)
field from DHCPv4 message
DHCPv6::drop
- Drops the packet silently
DHCPv6::hop_count
- Returns hop-count
field from DHCPv6 RELAY message
DHCPv6::len
- Returns the length of the DHCP
packet length
DHCPv6::link_address
- Returns link
address field from DHCPv6 RELAY message
DHCPv6::msg_type
- Returns msg-type
field from DHCPv6 message
DHCPv6::option
- Retrieves, sets or
deletes the option by id number x
DHCPv6::peer_address
- Returns peer
address field from DHCPv6 RELAY message
DHCPv6::reject
- Drops the packet while
sending ICMP packet about the drop reason
DHCPv6::transaction_id
- Returns
transaction-id field from DHCPv6 message
DNS::rpz_policy
- returns the RPZ policy
associated with the DNS cache
FLOWTABLE::count
- returns flow counts
FLOWTABLE::limit
- returns configured
connection limits
GTP::clone
- Returns a cloned copy of the GTP message.
GTP::forward
- Forwards GTP message to peer flow.
GTP::new
- Creates a new GTP message for given version & request-type
GTP::parse
- Creates a new GTP message from a byte stream
GTP::respond
- Sends the GTP message back to
the remote node of this connection
HTTP::proxy
- controls whether the BIG-IP
will handle the proxy of the connection locally or send it to a
downstream pool
HTTP2::active
- used to determine if a
request is generated by HTTP/2
HTTP2::disconnect
- allows you to
cleanly terminate the current HTTP/2 session
HTTP2::requests
- used to determine the
count of requests received in the current HTTP/2 session
HTTP2::stream
- Gets or sets the stream
attributes including id and priority
HTTP2::version
- used to determine the
HTTP/2 protocol version used
HTTP2::concurrency
- used to
determine the number of active concurrent streams in the current
HTTP/2 session
IP::ingress_drop_rate
- adds ip
with specified drop rate to black list table
IP::ingress_rate_limit
- sets
ingress graylist and global rate limit thresholds for the virtual
IP::intelligence
- returns a Tcl list
of IP intelligence category names for a given IP address
PROFILE::antifraud
- Returns the value of
an antifraud profile setting.
PROFILE::tftp
- Returns the value of an TFTP profile setting
`
PROFILE::vdi
- Returns the value of a VDI profile setting.
-
PSC::aaa_reporting_interval
- gets or sets AAA reporting interval
-
PSC::attr
- get the session lease time
-
PSC::auth_user_name
- get or set
authentication user name
PSC::calling_id
- get or set calling id
PSC::imeisv
- get or set imeisv value
PSC::imsi
- get or set the imsi value
PSC::ip_address
- get/set/remove ip
address(es)
PSC::lease_time
- get the session lease
time ( (
Note: the PSC::lease_time command currently not
supported
)
PSC::policy
- get/set/remove policies
PSC::subscriber_id
- get or set the
subscriber id
PSC::tower_id
- get or set tower id
PSC::user_name
- get or set user name
AAA::acct_result
- used to
check whether the accounting information is sent successfully to
IVS or not
AAA::acct_send
- used to send
user accouting information to IVS virtual
AAA::auth_result
- used to
check whether the authentication information is sent successfully
to IVS or not
AAA::auth_send
- used to send
user authentication information to IVS virtual
SIP::header
- Get or set SIP header
information
SIP::persist
- returns (or replaces) the
persistence key being used for the current message
SIP::route_status
- returns the
routing status of the current message
SSL::alpn
- Sets or retrieves the ALPN string
SSL::sessionsecret
- returns the
current SSL handshake master secret
TCP::abc
- enable or disable TCP appropriate
byte counting
TCP::autowin
- Sets the send and receive
buffer dynamically in accordance with measured connection
parameters
TCP::congestion
- sets the TCP
congestion control algorithm
TCP::delayed_ack
- will enable or
disable TCP delayed acknowledgements
TCP::dsack
- enable or disable TCP duplicate
selective acknowledgements
TCP::ecn
- enable or disable TCP explicit
congestion notification
TCP::idletime
- sets the TCP idle timeout
TCP::limxmit
- enable or disable TCP
limited transmit recovery
TCP::lossfilter
- sets the burst and
rate levels in which TCP ignores loss
TCP::pacing
- enable or disable TCP rate
pace
TCP::proxybuffer
- sets the TCP proxy
buffer thresholds
TCP::rcv_scale
- Returns the receive
window scale advertised by the remote host
TCP::rcv_size
- The maximum receive
window in bytes
TCP::recvwnd
- sets the TCP receive window
TCP::rto
- Retransmit timer value in
milliseconds
TCP::sendbuf
- sets the TCP send buffer
size
TCP::setmss
- sets the TCP max segment size
Events Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 11.6.0
ADAPT_REQUEST_HEADERS
- raised as
soon as any HTTP request headers have been returned from the IVS
ADAPT_RESPONSE_HEADERS
- raised
as soon as any HTTP response headers have been returned from the
IVS
CATEGORY_MATCHED
- triggered when a
custom category match (or prefix match) is found
FIX_HEADER
- Triggered when the system
finishes parsing a new FIX header
SIP_REQUEST_DONE
- aised when a
request message is received from the proxy after routing
SIP_RESPONSE_DONE
- raised when a
request message is received from the proxy after routing
Commands Deprecated or Removed in BIG-IP LTM 11.6.0
urlcatquery
- Query the URL for URL
categorization
